instrument_fixes.finding: G_SUPPORTFD verbatim (0.02 step) fails 54/54 NOT because the supports are wrong (disk supports verified cos 1.0000 vs fresh computation) but because the e226 step constant was calibrated on the BPE archive gradient scale: this organism support norms reach ~70, so 0.02*s_hat leaves the linear regime and p collapses; the same port-class as G_RECALIBRATION flip zone. The gates keep the verbatim FAIL; the scale-matched diagnostic (eps=0.05/||g||) co-reports whether the supports are true ascent directions

THE SUPPORT SIGN CONVENTION (resolved analytically + empirically at 23:2xZ): the stored supports are gradients of the LOSS -log p (downhill on p); e226's registered convention is grad p(answer|prompt) (uphill). Empirical: p(theta - eps*s_hat) - p0 = +3.78e-4 / +8.87e-4 at first-order target 1e-3 (probes 0/7), exactly the +grad p prediction. SIGN-INVARIANCE of every read except G_SUPPORTFD: coherence thetas (both supports flipped -> cos unchanged), seat_align Z and ratio_abs (uniform A flip), wind_cum (abs cos). G_SUPPORTFD is the only sign-casual consumer; it also carries a scale incompatibility (verbatim 0.02 step vs ||grad p|| up to ~125 overshoots the linear regime regardless of sign). Verdict vocabulary unchanged: the verbatim gate FAIL stands, disclosed with this analysis; the descriptive bars are unaffected.
